notes: «وعن أبي سخل عن سلمان» follows the first chain mid-report with no shaykh written: read as its own group from أبي سخل, not inheriting فضالة.
«عليه السلام» and «صلى الله عليه وآله» are blessings, left out. «أبي عبد الله» sits inside the chain after «عن»: narrator (owner ruling 2).
The saying («بينا انا جالس ...») is Salman's, so Salman is the last link of the second group.
